selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel boots with audit=1 (pre-change baseline showing param was absent)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline: pre-change /proc/cmdline and grubby --info=DEFAULT had no audit=1; boot_id 739c9792-2418-47cc-a875-95b27428f3fc, boot time 2026-09-29 08:17:50

selected_evidence.requirement: audit=1 persistently applied via grubby to all boot entries and /etc/kernel/cmdline
selected_evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" ran successfully; verification showed audit=1 in grubby --info=DEFAULT, /boot/loader/entries/*.conf (both normal and rescue), and /etc/kernel/cmdline

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node1 restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command issued via backgrounded setsid so ack returned immediately; next exec call timed out confirming node went down for restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id b3721708-41be-4eb1-89e0-f1c9588a7d77 differs from baseline 739c9792-2418-47cc-a875-95b27428f3fc, and uptime -s shows new boot time 08:18:43 vs prior 08:17:50

selected_evidence.requirement: audit=1 setting persists across reboot and kernel audit subsystem is active
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditctl -s reports 'enabled 1', and grubby --info=DEFAULT still shows audit=1 as the persistent default kernel args

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: baseline =="
cat /etc/os-release | head -5
echo "== boot identity (pre) =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s
echo "== current cmdline =="
cat /proc/cmdline
echo "== grubby default args (before) =="
sudo -n grubby --info=DEFAULT 2>&1 || true
echo "== STEP: apply audit=1 persistently =="
sudo -n grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"
echo "== STEP: verify grub config updated =="
sudo -n grubby --info=DEFAULT
echo "== grep grub.cfg for audit=1 =="
sudo -n grep -R "audit=1" /boot/loader/entries/ /boot/grub2/grub.cfg /etc/kernel/cmdline 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
setsid -f sh -c 'sleep 1; sudo -n reboot' >/dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null
echo "reboot scheduled"

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== post-reboot cmdline =="
cat /proc/cmdline
echo "== audit param check =="
grep -qo 'audit=1' /proc/cmdline && echo "AUDIT_ENABLED=yes" || echo "AUDIT_ENABLED=no"
echo "== auditd service status =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active auditd || true
echo "== kernel audit subsystem state (auditctl -s) =="
sudo -n auditctl -s 2>&1 || true
echo "== grubby default persists =="
sudo -n grubby --info=DEFAULT
